name: Loiu (Spain)
description: White field within a red frame, divided by a red diagonal from the upper hoist to the lower fly with a red lower hoist triangle, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Loiu (a tree and keys on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Loiu; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: lower hoist triangle below the diagonal
